summary: **Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer** is a 2D interactive space outpost management game designed to teach kids (ages 7–12) real engineering trade-offs in deep space survival. Players control an astronaut moving around a lunar or Martian habitat to monitor and maintain four core systems—**Life Support**, **Radiation Shielding**, **Power Grid**, and **Food Hydroponics**—while balancing depleting resources, mission time, and repair limits before time runs out.
details:
• Players take on the role of a Junior Commander managing a lunar or Martian outpost in a 2D interactive environment.
  • Instead of only clicking static menus, players move an astronaut character around the habitat using keyboard controls (WASD / Arrow keys) or mobile touch buttons, walk up to critical workstations, and press SPACE (or tap the repair button) to maintain systems before mission time runs out.
  • Four core outpost stations—Life Support (oxygen and water), Radiation Shielding, Power Grid, and Food Hydroponics—continuously degrade over time, requiring players to prioritize repairs, watch the Mission Control Log, and manage outpost integrity and mission score (with repair scoring capped once a station reaches 100% so players cannot farm points endlessly).
